subject: SUM clause
notes: All THREE addend forms are admitted, and the SUM keyword may appear more than once in one clause. arithmetic-expression-1 had no grammar surface at all (the SUM operand was a dataReference with a dead trailing OF report-name), so SUM WS-K + 1 died as COBOL0307 at every edition; the operand production is now shared with the SOURCE clause and BareReferenceOf is the one classifier that decides which form was written. RESIDUE: an expression addend written with a LEADING parenthesis (SUM (A * B)) is still refused, because the lexer's 8.4.3.2.3 SR2 keyword-omitted-intrinsic trigger on the SUM token pushes SUBSCRIPT mode at that '(' - against 13.18.54.3 SR9 - which is a distinct mechanism reported to the registrar. Every other spelling is live and 13.18.54.3 states no parenthesization rule that would force the refused one. kb/Work PB883.
